title: Adana Kebab

description: Adana Kebab is a succulent, hand-minced meat kebab traditionally grilled on wide iron skewers. Originating from the city of Adana in Turkey, it is renowned for its spicy flavor and juicy texture. This iconic dish is a staple of Turkish cuisine, often served with fresh vegetables, lavash bread, and a cooling ayran.

ingredients.notes: or a mix of lamb and beef

instructions.title: Prepare the Kebab Mixture
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, finely minced red bell pepper, red onion, garlic, red pepper paste, pul biber, sweet paprika, cumin, salt, black pepper, and optional lamb fat. Use your hands to thoroughly knead the mixture for at least 10-15 minutes until it becomes sticky and well combined. This is crucial for the meat to bind properly to the skewers.

instructions.title: Chill the Kebab Mixture
instructions.text: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate the meat mixture for at least 30 minutes, or preferably for 1-2 hours. Chilling helps the fat solidify and prevents the meat from falling off the skewers during grilling.

instructions.title: Preheat Grill and Skewer the Kebab
instructions.text: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat. If using charcoal, ensure the coals are glowing hot with a light ash coating. Divide the chilled meat mixture into 8-10 equal portions. Take a portion and firmly press it around a wide, flat metal skewer, shaping it evenly along the skewer to about 1 cm thickness. Ensure the meat adheres well to the skewer.

instructions.title: Grill the Adana Kebab
instructions.text: Place the skewered kebabs directly over the hot grill. Cook for about 3-4 minutes per side, turning frequently to ensure even cooking and to prevent burning. The kebabs should develop a beautiful char on the outside while remaining juicy and tender on the inside. Total grilling time will be approximately 12-15 minutes.

instructions.title: Rest and Prepare Accompaniments
instructions.text: Once cooked, remove the kebabs from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes. While they rest, quickly warm some lavash bread on the grill if desired. Prepare your serving accompaniments such as finely chopped red onion with sumac and parsley, sliced tomatoes, and fresh green chilies.

instructions.title: Serve Your Adana Kebab
instructions.text: Carefully slide the kebabs off the skewers onto warm serving plates or directly into warmed lavash bread. Serve immediately with the prepared accompaniments and a refreshing glass of ayran. Enjoy your authentic Turkish Adana Kebab!

tips: For the most authentic texture, ensure your ground meat is very cold and has a good fat content. Kneading it thoroughly is crucial for the mix to bind to the skewers and achieve the desired consistency.
Always use metal skewers that are wide and flat, not round. This design helps the meat cling better and prevents it from spinning or falling off during the grilling process.

Serve Adana Kebab immediately with freshly chopped onions, sumac, parsley, and thin lavash bread. A side of grilled tomatoes and peppers, along with a squeeze of fresh lemon, perfectly complements the rich flavors.
